scope: .github/scripts non-test implementations, all six workflows and publish-target composite; root agent owns the large Codex resource collector

machines.name: CI admission, impact selection and cancellation
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: GitHub event identity, workflow concurrency key, changes job outputs and impact artifact

transitions.guard: declared branch/event admission; PR and merge queue do not rely on push path filtering
transitions.effects: Create CI run; changes job computes path impact and Pi supported-version outputs.
transitions.failure_retry: Invalid changes evaluation fails and downstream selection cannot be treated as verified.

transitions.guard: at least one declared push path matches
transitions.effects: Create distinct run keyed by run ID; artifact impact is forced true for admitted main pushes.
transitions.failure_retry: A push entirely outside the trigger list has no run; no success evidence is produced.

transitions.event: new run for same pull request
transitions.guard: concurrency key matches; event is pull_request
transitions.effects: Cancel older run. Main push runs use distinct run IDs and are not canceled by this rule.
transitions.failure_retry: Canceled jobs remain canceled, not successful checks.

transitions.guard: domain source/config/test paths match
transitions.effects: Set string outputs consumed by job if conditions; upload the selection receipt.
transitions.failure_retry: Failure is a failed changes prerequisite; downstream skips do not establish domain correctness.

transitions.guard: domain has no matching changes and no unconditional override
transitions.effects: Omit expensive job execution; aggregate generally permits the explicit skipped result.
transitions.failure_retry: An intentional skip is not runtime evidence and cannot satisfy selected artifact stage checks.

machines.notes: Job admission and evidence are separate state planes. The full declared job inventory is retained in coverage metadata.

machines.name: Required CI aggregate and advisory lanes
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: GitHub needs.<job>.result and changes.outputs.artifacts

transitions.guard: aggregate always condition admits evaluation
transitions.effects: Collect required job results, selected artifact result, release candidate result and advisory results.
transitions.failure_retry: Failure to evaluate the aggregator is not a pass.

transitions.guard: every required result is success or skipped, auto-release-candidate is success, and selected artifact coverage is success
transitions.effects: Return success for ci-passed; successful main CI can trigger release workflow.
transitions.failure_retry: The additional strict candidate/artifact checks prevent generic skipped acceptance from bypassing those gates.

transitions.event: required failure, cancellation, unexpected result, or strict gate skip
transitions.guard: one required result violates acceptance predicates
transitions.effects: Exit nonzero; no CI success authorization.
transitions.failure_retry: Rerun after correcting cause; prior success on another commit/run is not substituted.

transitions.guard: lane is Pi latest, Codex latest, Claude coverage cell/merge or Pi coverage cell/merge
transitions.effects: Retain lane visibility/evidence; its status is excluded from required_results.
transitions.failure_retry: Advisory failure does not veto ci-passed. Comment naming only Pi latest is stale.

machines.name: Native candidate identity stamp and consumer binding
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: Candidate release manifest, binary/module hashes and exclusive Actions identity receipt

transitions.guard: producer job artifact-native-build; repository, clean exact source/workflow SHA, run/attempt, Go toolchain and native target all match
transitions.effects: Write candidate metadata exclusively with executable/module hashes and five-field candidate release manifest.
transitions.failure_retry: Existing metadata, linked/wrong payload, mismatched platform/source/toolchain or dirty checkout fails; never replace another identity.

transitions.guard: consumer is declared bridge, authority or engine job; same run/source/workflow; producer attempt no later than current attempt; payload digest exact
transitions.effects: Validate receipt; restore POSIX executable bit only on verified binary if required.
transitions.failure_retry: Cross-run, future-attempt, changed module/binary or unsupported consumer fails.

transitions.guard: recorded exact issuer identity, platform, source/module/toolchain and digests are valid
transitions.effects: Validate evidence without attempting to execute a foreign OS binary.
transitions.failure_retry: This is recorded producer evidence, not a new local execution result.

transitions.event: malformed, missing, duplicate-key or linked identity input
transitions.guard: closed shape and identity checks fail
transitions.effects: Raise diagnostic and stop promotion.
transitions.failure_retry: Repair/rebuild the candidate; do not waive an identity mismatch by rerunning only a later stage.

machines.name: Native qualification DAG, package assembly and cold-install matrix
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: Six platform build/coverage/qualification artifacts; seven required stage results; package cohort and 18 cold receipts

transitions.guard: matching native runners and pinned toolchain; test/build succeeds
transitions.effects: Publish platform candidates and associated test evidence; later bridges/authority consume these exact candidates.
transitions.failure_retry: Matrix failure does not authorize a subset as the complete cohort.

transitions.event: default, coverage, bridges and authority suites finish
transitions.guard: each selected required stage succeeds; coverage join meets 70% statement threshold and six-platform integration population
transitions.effects: Collect checked stage results and coverage observations.
transitions.failure_retry: Any failure or skipped required selected stage blocks engine qualification.

transitions.guard: exact seven-stage population, all success, changes artifacts selection true
transitions.effects: Accept result only under closed stage list; no success-by-omission.
transitions.failure_retry: Unknown, missing, duplicate, skipped or failed required stage rejects.

transitions.guard: exact 12 tested/context directories cover six platform candidates with bound identities
transitions.effects: Run builder qualification sequentially and write platform qualification receipts.
transitions.failure_retry: A later failure may leave earlier scratch receipts; workflow uploads qualification only after the successful step.

transitions.guard: all engine prerequisites succeeded
transitions.effects: Build qualified Claude/Codex/Pi archives and release cohort from exact native payloads.
transitions.failure_retry: Packaging or digest failure prevents downstream cold-install jobs.

transitions.event: cold-install three hosts on six platforms
transitions.guard: artifact identity checks pass; each host install, offline capability and workflow proof succeeds
transitions.effects: Emit one bound receipt per host/platform; receipts distinguish host-observed from synthetic policy evidence.
transitions.failure_retry: Host failures remain failures; !cancelled continuation retains later independent host diagnostics without inventing missing receipts.

transitions.guard: exact unique population of 18 receipts, hashes/source/run and required proof fields match
transitions.effects: Authorize publication consumer to use packages. Context qualifier, when present, additionally requires its declared proof.
transitions.failure_retry: Missing/duplicate receipts, shadow/native runtime download, or weak proof rejects.

machines.notes: The package cohort is an artifact qualification set, not ADR 40’s removed cross-plugin publication transaction. Per-plugin publication remains independent.

machines.name: Concurrent Python suite execution and observed result
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: Child processes, captured outputs and per-suite deadlines

transitions.guard: unique existing suite paths and valid timeout/interpreter
transitions.effects: Launch bounded concurrent child interpreters.
transitions.failure_retry: Duplicate/missing paths or invalid invocation fail before execution.

transitions.guard: process output available
transitions.effects: Capture stdout/stderr and return code; print grouped outputs after collection.
transitions.failure_retry: A zero exit alone is insufficient proof.

transitions.guard: per-child timeout exceeded
transitions.effects: Subprocess helper terminates the direct child and collects timeout diagnostic.
transitions.failure_retry: Not a declared process-tree kill; timeout rejects the suite.

transitions.guard: exit zero, a positive observed Ran count, accepted final count and OK marker
transitions.effects: Record observed execution rather than treating empty success as tests run.
transitions.failure_retry: Missing/contradictory/zero-test output fails.

transitions.guard: every suite observation verified
transitions.effects: Return success after all children are collected.
transitions.failure_retry: Any error returns nonzero after reporting each result; rerun explicitly.

machines.name: Authority suite discovery, partition, deadline and exact-coverage join
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: Discovered unittest IDs, class-preserving weighted plan, plan digest and exclusive observations

transitions.guard: nonempty unique actual test inventory; shard count within 1..32
transitions.effects: Group by fixture class, use weights only for scheduling, create nonempty disjoint plan and digest.
transitions.failure_retry: Invalid inventory/weights/partition fails; weights cannot remove tests.

transitions.guard: valid plan
transitions.effects: Run up to four child shards with common deadline and plan identity.
transitions.failure_retry: Spawn/deadline failures kill direct children and make the run fail; no broad process-tree guarantee.

transitions.guard: selection matches actual discoverable tests
transitions.effects: Collect per-test outcomes/timings and exclusive JSON observation.
transitions.failure_retry: wasSuccessful, testsRun, selected population and non-vacuous execution are checked; skips/expected failures do not supply missing substantive execution.

transitions.guard: same plan digest, every selected test appears exactly once, all required outcomes pass
transitions.effects: Return success and timings.
transitions.failure_retry: Missing, duplicate, foreign or failing observation rejects; no averaging over missing shards.

machines.name: Context verification evidence and installed invocation admission
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: Go module/source/executable digests, bounded Go JSON stream, named case proof and installed package receipts

transitions.guard: declared case and available exact toolchain/executable
transitions.effects: Snapshot source/module inputs; run offline isolated Go invocation with 120-second and output bounds.
transitions.failure_retry: Spawn, timeout or oversized output fails.

transitions.guard: named test/subtest population runs exactly once and passes; selected package passes once; no failed required test; source hashes unchanged
transitions.effects: Return bounded observation and execution duration.
transitions.failure_retry: Missing/repeated/skipped named test, malformed or too many records, source drift or package failure rejects.

transitions.guard: exact cohort/source/hash/platform/member set; release manifest is five fields or five plus context_qualification
transitions.effects: Verify contained regular package payload and required qualified native binary.
transitions.failure_retry: No acceptance of substituted/linked/wrong-source candidate; error stops admission.

transitions.guard: candidate preflight mode, plugin outside owned test repo, exact installed helper and absolute Python
transitions.effects: Return argv/env with empty PATH and Python -I -B; evidence records live_qualified=false.
transitions.failure_retry: Returns an invocation plan, not execution or live provider qualification; unsupported mode rejects.

machines.name: Create-only context fixture and evaluator/solver boundary
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: Closed fixture catalog, source hashes, new owned fixture directory and deterministic Git state

transitions.guard: closed fields, safe paths, exact bound fixture/case identities and valid contents
transitions.effects: Normalize a bounded fixture description and digest.
transitions.failure_retry: Duplicate keys, invalid paths/shapes or undeclared case rejects.

transitions.guard: trusted parent, create-only empty destination, input source hashes unchanged
transitions.effects: Create declared files and committed/unborn/detached/linked/sparse Git arrangement; keep evaluator data outside solver view.
transitions.failure_retry: Existing destination, linked/untrusted path or changed source rejects.

transitions.guard: postconditions and fixture snapshots hold
transitions.effects: Return fixture evidence and paths for later tests.
transitions.failure_retry: Failure can leave a partial owned fixture; a new destination or explicit cleanup is required for retry.

machines.notes: These fixtures model a proposed context oracle. Creation alone is neither a sandbox authority claim nor a live-host verification result.

machines.name: Coverage input binding, post-test receipt and multi-host union
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: Tracked committed source/config snapshot, coverage blob, checked receipt and fresh normalized output directory

transitions.guard: tracked committed tree, exact declared Vitest configs/source maps and new output receipt
transitions.effects: Write exclusive snapshot of source/config identities before tests.
transitions.failure_retry: Dirty/missing/linked/unexpected input rejects.

transitions.guard: same exact snapshot; coverage data file present and bounded
transitions.effects: Bind output blob digest in new checked receipt.
transitions.failure_retry: Source or configuration drift after measurement rejects; cannot rewrite old proof as current.

transitions.guard: complete closed triple of provenance, checked receipt and blob; same commit/tree/Vitest maps
transitions.effects: Normalize coverage into fresh output and label PARTIAL.
transitions.failure_retry: Missing components or mismatched hashes fail; one-host evidence is not labeled a union.

transitions.guard: both complete triples bind identical source identities
transitions.effects: Normalize filesystem paths, validate coverage graphs and combine host evidence; label UNION.
transitions.failure_retry: Foreign/malformed graph or differing source identity fails.

transitions.from_state: zero checked hosts or unexpected input entries
transitions.from: zero checked hosts or unexpected input entries
transitions.guard: closed set is empty or malformed
transitions.effects: Return error before the workflow’s later zero-blob branch.
transitions.failure_retry: The workflow’s zero-blob graceful fallback is unreachable after this validation succeeds.

transitions.guard: destination is fresh and safe
transitions.effects: Write normalized files, preserving meaningful positive branch counts while handling negative implicit-else artifacts.
transitions.failure_retry: I/O failure may leave partial scratch output; does not publish a successful receipt.

machines.name: Docker integration test-layer observation
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: Layer declarations discovered in real test source and runtime start records

transitions.guard: every declared layer has unique source/name and source inventory is nonempty
transitions.effects: Build the expected execution-layer population from test files.
transitions.failure_retry: Duplicate, missing or malformed declarations reject.

transitions.guard: all declared layers present, no unknown layers; enclosing npm test succeeded
transitions.effects: Return successful layer-coverage observation.
transitions.failure_retry: Records prove starts, not independent test finishes; test-run success supplies the completion prerequisite.

transitions.guard: one expected observation absent or foreign
transitions.effects: Exit nonzero with layer-specific errors.
transitions.failure_retry: No skip converted to proof; rerun suite with real declared layers.

machines.name: Real Codex installation, read-back and disposable-host lifecycle
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: CA_REQUIRE_CODEX, codex executable, disposable workspace home/cache and JSON result list

transitions.guard: runtime unavailable or unusable and CA_REQUIRE_CODEX is not 1
transitions.effects: Emit explicit status=skip with no checks; exit zero.
transitions.failure_retry: A successful exit with skip is not host installation or enforcement evidence.

transitions.guard: runtime unavailable or unusable and CA_REQUIRE_CODEX=1
transitions.effects: Emit status=fail and nonzero error.
transitions.failure_retry: Install usable runtime, then rerun.

transitions.guard: npm mode, if requested, matches checkout version and includes member receipt
transitions.effects: Remove previous disposable home, recreate it; npm mode writes exact-version temporary marketplace catalog.
transitions.failure_retry: Invalid mode arguments fail before installation; cleanup uses ignore_errors and does not itself prove deletion.

transitions.guard: host command returns zero
transitions.effects: Real Codex registers the provided local marketplace.
transitions.failure_retry: Nonzero records failure and ends check_install early; finally attempts home removal.

transitions.guard: host command returns zero
transitions.effects: Real host installs plugin into its cache.
transitions.failure_retry: Nonzero records failure and stops later checks; no fake source copy used as install proof.

transitions.guard: one exact enabled installed identity, manifest version and single cache version match; hooks, scripts and indexed literal/generic routes intact
transitions.effects: Record individual result codes and inspect installed cache resources.
transitions.failure_retry: Ambiguous/missing/disabled/wrong-version or missing-target state records failure. Hook event-key parity alone is not hook execution proof.

transitions.event: qualified npm member check / capability check
transitions.guard: requested flags; exact installed member size/hash set and offline native capabilities required
transitions.effects: Load installed bridge and call native capabilities; require operations/default enabled and runtime_downloads=false.
transitions.failure_retry: Missing/substituted/linked engine or bad capability response fails.

transitions.guard: finally block reached
transitions.effects: Attempt recursive removal of disposable host home; then emit overall pass/fail for accumulated results.
transitions.failure_retry: Installation subcommands have no _run timeout; unexpected exception can escape before final JSON. No provider turn is invoked.

machines.notes: The baseline installation lane is a real host check. It does not establish model-turn hook dispatch or blocking behavior; that is a separate evidence plane.

machines.name: Trusted static Codex candidate verification and exact-commit provenance
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: Trusted checker checkout, candidate archive bytes, resource closure and optional expected hashes

transitions.guard: lowercase 40-character commit resolves exactly; existing candidate checkout
transitions.effects: Git-archive only plugins/ca-codex into temporary zip; load executable verifier only from trusted checker location.
transitions.failure_retry: Bad ref/tree or archive failure rejects; candidate scripts are not executed.

transitions.guard: archive bound; safe file population and frontmatter; ca-codex SemVer manifest; approved canonical hook-manifest digest and present target scripts
transitions.effects: Validate declarative package/resource closure and compute deterministic package/resource hashes.
transitions.failure_retry: Unknown hook inventory, unsafe package, malformed duplicate JSON/frontmatter or missing resource rejects.

transitions.guard: every supplied lowercase SHA-256 equals observed archive/package/resource hash
transitions.effects: Emit PASS with source commit/tree, archive/package/resource identities, version and resource/read counts; delete temporary archive.
transitions.failure_retry: Mismatch returns FAIL/nonzero; static pass is not a live hook execution proof.

transitions.guard: same exact Git-commit/archive/hash binding; trusted resource checker candidate_static_contract
transitions.effects: Return source/archive/package/resource identities from the resource-checker contract.
transitions.failure_retry: Retained distinct wrapper uses the resource checker rather than the newer dedicated static-package checker; no candidate executable is loaded.

transitions.event: invalid schema, digest or source identity
transitions.guard: validation exception
transitions.effects: Emit FAIL errors and nonzero exit; no publication effect.
transitions.failure_retry: Fix package or use exact expected candidate; no acceptance-by-retry of mismatched identity.

machines.notes: The root agent separately owns the complete 3,421-line resource-closure/live probe implementation; this family covers these two wrappers and the dedicated static checker.

machines.name: Upstream runtime canaries and advisory evidence
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: Latest runtime install/probe step outcomes and GitHub step summary

transitions.event: install latest upstream and run admission/platform probes
transitions.guard: declared baseline harness/toolchain available
transitions.effects: Execute compatibility checks; probe failures are captured for later summary.
transitions.failure_retry: Harness/setup failures can fail job; semantic probe failures are absorbed at step level.

transitions.guard: summary harness can evaluate outcomes
transitions.effects: Emit compatible or warning receipt in step summary.
transitions.failure_retry: Receipt-production failure remains visible; aggregator excludes the lane from required set.

transitions.guard: install and probe steps are configured continue-on-error
transitions.effects: Record install/probe outcomes and always print advisory summary.
transitions.failure_retry: Checker can return explicit skip without CA_REQUIRE_CODEX; install outcome must be read alongside exit code.

transitions.guard: lane is declared advisory
transitions.effects: Preserve evidence without vetoing ci-passed.
transitions.failure_retry: No promotion of baseline compatibility merely because latest-watch did not block merge.

machines.name: Shipped payload scope and version-spending gate
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: Base commit, shipped-path diff, manifest versions, declared tag namespace and local tag inventory

transitions.event: resolve base and compute shipped diff
transitions.guard: base resolves; plugin is declared
transitions.effects: Diff plugin excluding tools build directory, then separately include declared committed bundles.
transitions.failure_retry: Unresolvable base/Git errors fail; unknown plugin is usage error.

transitions.guard: no shipped files changed
transitions.effects: Return success without demanding version increment.
transitions.failure_retry: No release side effect.

transitions.guard: HEAD version exists and strict SemVer parses; base version read returns None
transitions.effects: Return success as first-introduction case.
transitions.failure_retry: base_version also returns None for malformed/missing base version, so this branch conflates absence with invalid base manifest.

transitions.guard: current strictly greater than base; declared namespace unique/present; current tag absent
transitions.effects: Return success authorizing changed payload under new version.
transitions.failure_retry: Malformed declaration, basename collision, missing namespace or already-existing version tag rejects.

transitions.guard: version does not strictly advance, or tag already exists
transitions.effects: Return blocking diagnostic requiring unused advanced version.
transitions.failure_retry: A missing public tag does not rescue a version already present on base; bump and merge new intent.

machines.notes: Pi uses its dedicated build-host-packages release guard owned by the host agent; this gate deliberately covers Claude, sandbox and Codex.

machines.name: Automatic release candidate intent and pre-tag enforcement
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: Exact candidate commit, declared target manifests/payload/changelog, tag inventory and latest first-parent changelog intent

transitions.guard: complete declarations, manifests agree at exact commit; no manifest behind latest stable tag
transitions.to: already-current target or new target intent
transitions.effects: Compute per-target eligibility from tag precedence.
transitions.failure_retry: Missing surface, malformed declaration, inconsistent manifests or behind-tag version rejects entire check.

transitions.guard: manifest not newer than latest target tag
transitions.effects: Skip new-intent checks for that target.
transitions.failure_retry: No publication authorization is created by this row.

transitions.guard: latest first-parent changelog change carries same version and declared release surfaces unchanged through candidate
transitions.effects: Authorize candidate as bound release intent.
transitions.failure_retry: Payload/artifact/manifest drift after intent rejects; need new committed intent.

transitions.guard: all declared pre-tag commands exit zero within timeout
transitions.effects: Run declared commands in restricted environment; ci-passed explicitly requires this job success.
transitions.failure_retry: Any pre-tag nonzero raises CandidateError and blocks required CI.

transitions.guard: release preflight invokes same declared checks with warning fallback
transitions.effects: Collect warning on failure while release job can continue.
transitions.failure_retry: This does not undo the earlier required CI gate; ADR 40 advisory policy is not implemented consistently across both entry points.

machines.name: Release source selection, per-target eligibility and concurrency recheck
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: Successful CI run/source commit, local tag inventory, paginated release observations and per-target mutex

transitions.guard: successful named CI, push/main, same repository owner and source ancestry
transitions.effects: Select exact workflow_run head SHA/run ID and detached checkout; later main advance is allowed if source remains ancestor.
transitions.failure_retry: Wrong event/repository/ref/conclusion or missing identity rejects.

transitions.guard: workflow runs on main; latest successful push CI for main exists and its SHA is ancestor of current origin/main
transitions.effects: Select that successful run’s source and artifacts, which may be older than main current head.
transitions.failure_retry: Workflow input description says current head; implementation does not enforce equality.

transitions.guard: no previous stable tag, or version is newer, or own tag exists with unpublished release
transitions.effects: Set target output true; filter optional manual target; siblings remain independent.
transitions.failure_retry: Observation/parse error marks target false and contributes separate failure job while eligible siblings continue.

transitions.guard: same version has an already-public release
transitions.effects: Skip target job even if publication receipt is missing.
transitions.failure_retry: This predicate lacks completeness information; see reproduced recovery hole C-F01.

transitions.guard: previous job for same target completes; cancel-in-progress=false
transitions.effects: Refetch tags/release state immediately before invoking publisher.
transitions.failure_retry: Freshly published version becomes no-op; failed/rejected observation prevents publication.

transitions.guard: exact source and target declarations retained
transitions.effects: Invoke composite with source commit, successful CI run and target-specific credentials.
transitions.failure_retry: A matching tag at a different source is rejected by publisher as spent, not moved.

machines.name: Per-target publication saga and incomplete public-release recovery
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: Remote annotated tag, GitHub draft/public release, asset names/digests, marketplace/npm state and final receipt

sources.symbol: Create and push the annotated tag
Upload and read back the package asset

transitions.event: verify inputs and observe remote plan
transitions.guard: manifest/companion/changelog versions agree; CI cohort and source match; existing tag, if any, peels to exact source
transitions.effects: Download same-run artifacts; verify hashes/cold matrix; select missing assets and create/present states.
transitions.failure_retry: Duplicate release, spent tag or bad package rejects before additional publishing.

transitions.guard: plan says create and exact source is bound
transitions.effects: Create annotated version tag with changelog-derived release date and push.
transitions.failure_retry: Push error may be indeterminate remote state; next attempt observes first. Never move an existing tag.

source.symbol: Create and push the annotated tag

transitions.event: read back and capture tag identity
transitions.guard: remote peel equals exact intended source
transitions.effects: Read tag and attempt exclusive identity receipt; retain artifact even on later failure.
transitions.failure_retry: Mismatch fails; receipt is current observation, not automatically original-publication history.

transitions.guard: no release exists for target tag
transitions.effects: POST draft=true non-prerelease with extracted notes; existing draft/public release ID is reused.
transitions.failure_retry: API failure leaves tag; rerun observes whether draft was created.

transitions.guard: required package asset missing or already present
transitions.effects: Upload only missing asset; download remote asset and verify exact SHA-256.
transitions.failure_retry: Existing wrong bytes fail; no overwrite. Partial network failure resolved by fresh observation.

source.symbol: Upload and read back the package asset

transitions.guard: qualified package and immutable distribution identity pass host publisher checks
transitions.effects: Claude pushes immutable distribution and marketplace channel; Codex publishes immutable distribution then advances marketplace separately.
transitions.failure_retry: Partial remote refs remain and are observed by subsequent helper invocation; host helper ledger details are separate.

transitions.guard: exact package and trusted source commit; integrity, signature and repository/workflow/source provenance verified
transitions.effects: Publish exact tarball if absent; otherwise reuse exact version; verify public registry identity.
transitions.failure_retry: An accepted npm version can remain while GitHub release is draft; no republish of different bytes.

transitions.from_state: channel verified or sandbox no channel
transitions.from: channel verified or sandbox no channel
transitions.guard: all preceding required target steps pass
transitions.effects: PATCH draft=false when needed; read back public state and matching tag; output release-state=published.
transitions.failure_retry: Public state is externally visible before final receipt upload. Readback failure may be indeterminate and requires observation.

transitions.guard: planner listed codearbiter-publication.json missing
transitions.effects: Build metadata receipt and POST final JSON asset.
transitions.failure_retry: Upload failure leaves a public incomplete release. Outer eligibility and per-job recheck then skip it, despite plan() seeing the missing asset.

transitions.guard: planner did not list receipt as missing
transitions.effects: Print already attached and return without read-back of receipt bytes.
transitions.failure_retry: Presence by name is not receipt-content verification.

transitions.guard: target remains eligible and exact original source/artifacts retained
transitions.effects: Remote-first planner avoids duplicate tag/asset/channel writes.
transitions.failure_retry: Recovery is blocked for already-public incomplete state by C16; no automatic rollback of published effects exists.

machines.notes: An independent per-target saga is already present even though ADR 40 rejects a cross-plugin resume/continuation state machine. Explicit per-target state and completion criteria would document existing behavior rather than reintroduce cohort coupling.

machines.name: npm registry identity, trusted publication and bounded read-back
machines.explicitness: implicit control state with explicit outcome labels
machines.state_storage: Registry version/integrity/attestation metadata, exact tarball, isolated npm verification install and polling deadline

transitions.guard: exact E404 package/version-not-found response
transitions.effects: Authorize publish path for an unclaimed version.
transitions.failure_retry: Other errors are not absence; do not publish on ambiguous lookup failure.

transitions.guard: declared rate-limit/server/network error
transitions.effects: Raise RegistryUnavailable so bounded readback may retry.
transitions.failure_retry: Non-retryable or malformed response fails immediately.

transitions.guard: exact requested version and expected integrity; valid trusted attestation metadata
transitions.effects: Skip duplicate publish and proceed to independent authenticity verification.
transitions.failure_retry: Version/integrity mismatch fails as immutable identity conflict.

transitions.event: registry lookup success without required attestation metadata
transitions.guard: version/integrity exact but attestation unavailable
transitions.effects: Return present-unattested only when caller explicitly permits pending attestation; default lookup rejects.
transitions.failure_retry: Initial existing-version path can fail until attestation appears; post-publish poll permits temporary pending state.

transitions.guard: GITHUB_SHA equals source commit; reviewed npm CLI; workflow OIDC configured
transitions.effects: Publish exact prebuilt tarball with ignore-scripts, provenance and public access; no static token fallback.
transitions.failure_retry: Trust failure stops; if registry accepted bytes before failure, rerun observes same immutable version.

transitions.guard: within 600-second deadline
transitions.effects: Every 15 seconds retry absent, unavailable or present-unattested states.
transitions.failure_retry: Integrity/identity mismatch is immediate failure; deadline expiry leaves GitHub release unpublished.

transitions.guard: isolated install/audit signatures succeeds with exact package identity and one verified provenance
transitions.effects: Create temporary clean npm config/cache, strip token/config env, install with ignore-scripts, run audit signatures.
transitions.failure_retry: Missing/invalid signature/attestation or unexpected package fails; active inline publish lane has no internal signature retry.

findings.status: pure local decision probe reproduced; remote interruption not executed
findings.title: A public Release missing its final receipt cannot enter the advertised rerun recovery path
findings.claim: The composite publishes and reads back the Release before attaching codearbiter-publication.json. If that upload fails, plan() still reports a missing receipt, but eligible() rejects the already-public release. Both preflight and per-job recheck use eligible(), so retry skips the necessary remaining effect.
findings.probe: audit-work/probe_release_recovery_results.json: existing exact tag + public release + zero assets yields eligible=false while plan.missing-assets=codearbiter-publication.json
findings.recommendation: Make eligibility depend on verified target completion, or place the required receipt before the public transition. Preserve immutable tags/assets and allow only observed missing effects on retry.
findings.ux_dx_ax: Users can distinguish fully published from incomplete; maintainers get a working rerun; agents receive a precise resumable next action instead of contradictory eligible/plan results.

findings.title: Manual release description promises current main while source selection chooses latest successful main CI
findings.claim: The workflow accepts the latest successful main-push CI source if it is an ancestor of origin/main; it does not require equality to current main. This can be the correct artifact-bound recovery policy, but the UI/comment contract is different.
findings.recommendation: Show the exact selected CI run and source SHA in the manual action/result. Document latest successful main CI as the default or explicitly require current-head equality if owner policy demands it; do not silently change recovery semantics.

findings.title: Release-skill pre-tag proof is effectively a required gate despite ADR 40 retaining it as advisory
findings.claim: release.yml warns on declared pre-tag failure, but the required auto-release-candidate CI job invokes --run-pre-tag and raises on nonzero. ci-passed explicitly requires this job success. ADR 44 supersedes ADR 40 only for Pi npm signatures/attestation, leaving other advisory checks in force.
findings.recommendation: Obtain a governed policy decision on whether pre-tag proof is required, then encode the enforcement class once and derive both CI and publication behavior. Do not loosen a current required gate merely to make prose agree.

findings.title: Route compatibility publication clock has an implementation but no current release-workflow observation call
findings.claim: The checker implements planned/tag-only/draft/published/api-unavailable/mismatch and an API lookup, but current CI uses declarations/tests and neither release.yml nor publish-target calls observe/api-lookup. The CI comment assigning the post-publication audit to release.yml is not borne out by its contents. compatibility.removalRequires is not read by this checker.
findings.recommendation: Wire explicit non-mutating publication observation and retain its evidence if the compatibility clock is a real policy dependency; publish the declaration-only state until then. Keep removal policy adjudication separate from a field that is merely stored.

findings.title: Dedicated docs voice gate does not select PRs changing only its two rule implementation files
findings.claim: docs.yml includes .github/scripts/check_site_voice.py and core/pysrc/_sloplib.py under push paths but omits both under pull_request paths. The explanatory comment claims rule edits select the gate. Other CI tests may cover the rules, but this dedicated current-site voice run is not selected by those PR-only edits.
findings.recommendation: Generate or share the trigger input set for this gate, preserving deliberate event differences while adding its own implementation inputs to the PR selection contract.

findings.title: A successful exit sometimes means unavailable or optional skip, not verified protection/runtime
findings.claim: Ordinary tag audit permits unavailable API/no token; branch protection audit permits unknown fields without definite violation; optional Codex host check permits missing runtime. These are intentional branches but green status alone erases the evidence distinction for consumers.
findings.recommendation: Preserve existing exit compatibility while exposing a shared typed verdict such as verified, skipped, unavailable, rejected, including reasons and applicable scope. Let each gate declare which verdicts it accepts.

findings.status: source-confirmed branch conflation, no current base defect asserted
findings.title: Payload first-introduction classification conflates absent base manifest and invalid base version
findings.claim: base_version returns None for failed git show and for JSON/missing/non-string version. gate interprets every None as first introduction and returns success once current version is valid. Resolving the base commit first does not distinguish a present malformed manifest from an absent one.
findings.recommendation: Use distinct absent, valid and invalid read outcomes. Keep genuine new-plugin admission but reject invalid base evidence with a precise diagnostic.

findings.title: Two verification subprocess paths lack a bounded wait before their normal timeout path
findings.claim: Codex host _run has no timeout for marketplace/install/list commands. Pi production benchmark blocks in stdout.readline before communicate(timeout=30), so a child that never emits its first line can wait without that 30-second bound. No observed hang is asserted.
findings.recommendation: Make pending execution an explicit deadline/cancel outcome, preserving partial diagnostics and cleanup; characterize child-process termination requirements before changing process handling.

adr_assessments.status: accepted in source; implementation compared rather than presumed
adr_assessments.supported: Independent per-target jobs, immutable existing-tag check, exact asset readback and dormant Codex npm helpers are implemented.
adr_assessments.conflicts: Its universal rerun recovery claim has C-F01 counterexample. Its release-skill pre-tag advisory policy conflicts with required CI in C-F03.
adr_assessments.decision: Keep independent target publication and immutable artifact rules. Define a per-target completion predicate and govern the enforcement-class inconsistency; do not reintroduce cross-target cohort locking.

adr_assessments.status: accepted in source; live npm account configuration not observed
adr_assessments.supported: Active publish command uses OIDC provenance and no static token fallback; exact integrity, signatures and repo/workflow/source attestation gate finishing GitHub release, including recovery of existing versions.
adr_assessments.limits: Source inspection cannot verify npm trusted-publisher account configuration or an actual successful release. ADR explicitly requires live qualification.
adr_assessments.decision: Retain fail-closed identity gate and pending-draft recovery; expose pending registry/attestation states with their deadline and next action.

decision.recommendation: Use one closed, versioned transition-and-effect contract per domain with shared typed outcomes, source/evidence identity, idempotency key and completion predicate; derive CLI discoverability, human/agent next-action views, gate policy and transition tests. Keep independent domains and existing adapters.
decision.first_slice: Publication eligibility and plan must share the exact completion predicate, then synchronize the derived-output/manifest/limit registries found by native and host audits. Preserve public formats, immutable tags/bytes, target independence, read-before-write and distinct unknown/skip/verified semantics.
decision.preservation: Introduce observational shadow comparison and characterization tests for acceptance/rejection/no-op/partial failure/retry before routing existing entry points through pure decisions. Do not promise always/no regressions; require exact-artifact and platform evidence before changing release claims.

coverage.tests: Test implementation files were not exhaustively read for this hosted ledger. Findings are source-confirmed except the saved pure local release recovery classifier probe. No GitHub, npm, Pages, marketplace or credential effects were executed.
coverage.boundary: Control and persisted state families are inventoried. Pure parser iteration, per-item validation loops, format rendering and arithmetic are not inflated into additional product state machines. Their files were still fully read.
